verdicts.reason: Move plus parametrize consolidation, verified assertion-by-assertion. The parent's tests/test_corner_cases.py had test_hidden_option and test_hidden_option_no_rich; the commit moves them into a new tests/test_hidden.py as one test_hidden_option parametrized over use_rich in {False, True(needs_rich)}, and the use_rich=False leg carries the exact five assertions of the deleted unit verbatim (Say hello present, --name absent, /lastname, TEST_LASTNAME, (dynamic)) with the same HAS_RICH monkeypatch. The asset module is a pure git rename (corner_cases.py -> hidden_option.py, 0 changes) and the diff adds test_hidden_commands covering the 2-line typer/core.py bug actually being fixed, so oracle coverage strictly increased. The unit name genuinely disappears from the repo, which defeats name-based move detection: this is the move-credit family compounded by a name-erasing parametrize merge. Reporting defect worth a ticket: the finding's file field is an empty string.
